We got no templates matching those criteria. Maybe need to adjust criteria. The reaction is carbonyl-ene intramolecular forming a five-membered ring (likely a cyclic product). The target molecule is given with a fluorinated carbon attached to a cyclopentane? Let's examine SMILES: [CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]

Interpretation: There's an alkene CH2= C attached to aromatic ring (c1... phenyl) and also attached to chiral carbon 9 which is part of a cyclobutane? Actually C@@H:9 is attached to a cyclobutane? It says [C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])... So a cyclopentane (5-membered) with OH at carbon 13, and carbon 13 also attached to CF3 group (C:15 with three Fs). So the product is a cyclopentanol with CF3 substituent, plus an exocyclic alkene attached to aromatic ring and carbon 9? The carbonyl-ene reaction would involve a carbonyl (ketone) and an alkene within same molecule, forming a new C-C bond and OH. So the precursor likely is a ketone (maybe a cyclopentanone) and an alkene (allylic). The product has OH (aliphatic hydroxyl) and a new C-C bond, and the carbonyl is gone. So we need a template that does carbonyl-ene retro: break C-O bond (forming carbonyl) and break C-C bond (forming alkene). The template likely is something like: [C:1]=[C:2][C:3](=O)[C:4]>>[C:1][C:2]=[C:3][C:4]O? Not sure.

We can search without functional group criteria, just maybe bonds changed. Let's try search with bonds broken/formed. The forward reaction: C=C bond becomes C-C (so bond order change). C=O becomes C-O (order change). So bonds_order_changed: "6-6 (2.0->1.0)"? Not sure format. Might be easier to search without criteria and then filter manually.

Search with just molecule_smiles and limit 20.
